en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $NVDA, $AMD and $AVGO are reportedly looking to invest up to $5B combined in $META, and notes the irony that Nvidia could be funding a customer working with Broadcom to reduce its reliance on Nvidia GPUs, which shows how valuable Meta's future chip orders are. The quoted post says Meta plans a $35B equity raise ($22.5B Class A stock, $12.5B mandatory convertible preferred) as Q4 CapEx could reach about $55B after its first negative FCF quarter in over a decade.
text:
$NVDA, $AMD and $AVGO are reportedly looking to invest up to $5B combined in $META. 

The irony is Nvidia could be funding a customer that's working with Broadcom to reduce its reliance on Nvidia GPUs which shows just how valuable securing Meta's future chip orders has become
